# Floating Goat

> Floating Goat is a Copenhagen venue and accommodation located beside Langebro.

## Products

- [Simple Meetings](https://www.floatinggoat.dk/simple-meetings): Private events and celebrations.
- [Private Events](https://www.floatinggoat.dk/events/private-selskaber): Events for businesses and organizations.


## About

- [About Floating Goat](https://www.floatinggoat.dk/about): About the venue and its location beside Langebro.
- [Contact](https://www.floatinggoat.dk/contact): Contact and booking information.
